name: le_scalar_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::le_.Scalar(Tensor(a!) self, Scalar other) -> Tensor(a!). Compares self with a scalar in place, stores zero-or-one values in self's dtype, and returns the same Tensor object and storage. Tests cover scalar boundaries, floating dtypes, zero-sized and noncontiguous tensors, mutation, exact values, and identity.
